QRPFilter.description: One field filter of a request.

VALUE.description: Value as text; for In, values separated by commas.

QRPColumn.description: One column descriptor of a page, in record field order.

TYPE.description:
Scalar type of the field as declared in the standard, e.g. "string",
"double", "int64", "bool", "enum".

UNIT.description: Unit of the field when the standard declares one, else empty.

SORTABLE.description: True when the serving node can order the page by this column.

INDEXED.description: True when the serving node holds an index on this column.

QRP.description: Query Page - request, page header or error frame.

ERROR_CODE.description: Stable error code when STATUS is Error, Busy or Cold.

MESSAGE.description: Human-readable detail for an error, warning or partial page.

RETRY_AFTER_MS.description: Milliseconds a client should wait before retrying; 0 = no advice.

SCHEMA_NAME.description: Standard code of the records selected, e.g. "OMM".

FILE_IDENTIFIER.description: File identifier of the record frames that follow a page header.

SQL.description: SQL selection over the standard's table, when the lane accepts SQL.

SEARCH.description: Free-text search over the standard's indexed text fields.

PRODUCER_PEER_ID.description: Restrict to records whose producer is this peer.

ORIGIN_ID.description: Restrict to records retrieved from this upstream origin.

NEXT_CURSOR.description: Opaque cursor of the next page; empty when this is the last page.

RECORD_COUNT.description: Record frames that follow this page header.

TOTAL_COUNT.description: Records matching the selection when known; 0 = unknown.

SCANNED.description: Records the serving node scanned to build this page.

STORED.description: Records the serving node holds for the standard.

PARTIAL.description: True when a bounded scan returned before covering every stored record.

TRUNCATED.description: True when the page was cut at a byte or row budget.

AS_OF_MS.description: Unix milliseconds the serving numbers were last true.

STALE.description: True when the page was served from a stale snapshot.

ELAPSED_MS.description: Milliseconds the serving node spent producing the page.

GENERATED_AT_MS.description: Unix milliseconds when the page was generated.

ETAG.description: Entity tag of the page for conditional requests.

CID.description:
Content identifier named by a request or a reply (record, manifest,
archive).

ARCHIVE_ID.description: Archive identifier named by a request or a reply.
